explanation: The centering lease made real progress but then exhausted its calls at a 0.766 mm pose residual against a 0.5 mm tolerance. That is not evidence that placement geometry failed, and repeating the same tiny command would waste resources. This repair independently measures the actual frame-255 package pose from the supplied visible semantic landmarks and fresh RGB-D, revalidates visible bowl-rim surfaces, and tests the resulting containment and opening-height margins. It neither extrapolates attachment nor relaxes the containment inequality. The supplied image annotations are explicitly frame-bound and source-labelled, not represented as another GPT review. If actual geometry is sufficient, no additional centering motion is needed. The one remaining review is reserved for actual post-release cavity placement, followed by the existing temporal stability measurements. A fresh correction in any other state requires enough review budget to reassess its outcome and still verify placement.
interface: Apply these exact replacements to main(api). Preserve existing acquisition, grasp, retention, semantic recovery, and final verification. The repair adds a frame-255 observation adapter using visible print/corner annotations, current calibrated RGB-D, the saved semantic reference definitions, and current rim samples. Its measurements are checked for plane quality, edge length, independent landmark agreement, registration uncertainty, bowl consistency, and actual hand/object motion agreement. Checkpoints retain measurement provenance and cannot substitute for fresh observations after motion. The legacy release_review checkpoint key explicitly identifies supplied-image evidence when used rather than claiming an api.review call. Release requires actual containment and height margins, current local evidence, and a reserved post-release review. No repeated stalled correction or automatic reopening during transfer occurs. main returns JSON-compatible completion_proposed and evidence; native success remains independently evaluated.
jev_protocol: Keep all seven existing control questions unchanged. Each named world translation or rotation axis maps its increase/decrease/within_tolerance relation to positive/negative/hold; gripper maps the explicit objective to open/close/keep. Numerical geometry, registration, motion residuals, uncertainty, and tolerances remain Python computations. A centering lease, if justified and budgeted, uses a 1.5 mm pose tolerance and at most eight calls; reached is not a placement verdict, and stalled or exhausted receipts trigger measurement rather than another push. Source-labelled local evidence distinguishes no observed external obstruction from certified clearance and self-occlusion from unobserved space. The remaining structured review judges actual post-release inside/on_rim/outside/unknown and resting/moving_or_contact/unknown outcomes. Tracker or independently sampled fixed-view RGB-D then supplies temporal evidence; Jev is not asked to infer hidden object state or calculate metrics.
